_comment: OpenAI first-party wire. The api-key Connection speaks Chat Completions unless a Model entry selects public Responses; the subscription Connection is the ChatGPT Codex Responses endpoint for every Model. Chat Completions accepts reasoning_effort 'none', wants explicit non-strict Tool schemas and carries images, wav/mp3 audio and PDF documents. Public Responses accepts max_output_tokens and top_p as its only optional parameters, carries images and PDF documents, and treats a Model the catalog does not know as a reasoning Model. Codex rejects every optional parameter (so no output limit is budgeted), carries images only and never receives the 'none' effort.

gpt-5.6.note: Public reasoning guidance documents reasoning.context all_turns for GPT-5.6; it is not sent on Codex.

gpt-6-astra.note: Codex rejected effort none with HTTP 400 on 2026-09-10; off asks for the lowest accepted effort.

gpt-6-luna.note: Chat Completions restricts function calling to effort none, so the Platform uses Responses. Codex support for none is unverified; off is low there.

gpt-6-sol.note: Chat Completions restricts function calling to effort none, so the Platform uses Responses. Codex support for none is unverified; off is low there.

gpt-6.1-sol.note: The ladder is low..max; Codex rejected none and minimal with HTTP 400 on 2026-10-02, so off is low on both Connections.

verified.evidence: scripts/verify_wire_profile.py: send, stream, effort:low, effort:medium, effort:high, effort:xhigh, effort:max, effort:none, sampling, tool_replay, replay, image
